struct Graph {
  vector<Node> nodes;
  vector<Edge> edges;

  Graph(int nr_nodes, int nr_edges) {
    nodes.resize(nr_nodes);
    edges.reserve(nr_edges);
  }

  void add_edge(int from, int to, double length) {
    edges.emplace_back(from, to, length);
    nodes[from].out.push_back(edges.size()-1);
  }

  vector<int> find_augmenting_path(int source, int sink,
      vector<double> flow, double *path_cap) {
    set<pair<double, int>, greater<pair<double,int>>> q;
    vector<double> capacity(nodes.size(), 0);
    vector<int> pred(nodes.size(), -1);

    capacity[source] = INFINITY;
    q.emplace(INFINITY, source);

    while (!q.empty() && capacity[sink] == 0) {
      double cap = q.begin()->first;
      int n = q.begin()->second;
      q.erase(q.begin());

      for (int idx : nodes[n].out) {
        Edge &e = edges[idx];
        double e_cap = e.length - flow[idx];
        if (e_cap > 0 && min(cap, e_cap) > capacity[e.to]) {
          q.erase({capacity[e.to], e.to});
          capacity[e.to] = min(cap, e_cap);
          q.emplace(capacity[e.to], e.to);
          pred[e.to] = idx;
        }
      }
    }

    *path_cap = capacity[sink];
    vector<int> path;
    for (int e_idx = pred[sink]; e_idx != -1; e_idx = pred[edges[e_idx].from])
      path.push_back(e_idx);
    return path;
  }

  double max_flow(int source, int sink) {
    Graph residual(nodes.size(), 2*edges.size());
    vector<double> flow(2*edges.size(), 0);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
      residual.add_edge(edges[i].from, edges[i].to, edges[i].length);
      residual.add_edge(edges[i].to, edges[i].from, 0);
    }

    double max_flow = 0;
    double path_cap;
    vector<int> path;
    while ((path = residual.find_augmenting_path(source, sink, flow, &path_cap)).size() && path_cap > 0) {

struct Network {
  vector<Vertex> vertices;
  vector<Edge> edges;

  Network(int V, int E_capacity) {
    vertices.resize(V);
    edges.reserve(E_capacity);
  }

  void link(int u, int v, double cap) {
    edges.emplace_back(u, v, cap);
    vertices[u].incident_edges.push_back(int(edges.size()) - 1);
  }

  vector<int> find_path(int src, int dst, const vector<double>& flow, double* bottleneck) {
    using State = pair<double, int>;
    set<State, greater<State>> pq;
    vector<double> best_cap(vertices.size(), 0.0);
    vector<int> prev_edge(vertices.size(), -1);

    best_cap[src] = numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
    pq.emplace(best_cap[src], src);

    while (!pq.empty() && best_cap[dst] == 0) {
      auto [cap, node] = *pq.begin();
      pq.erase(pq.begin());

      for (int eid : vertices[node].incident_edges) {
        const Edge& e = edges[eid];
        double residual = e.capacity - flow[eid];
        if (residual > 0) {
          double new_cap = min(cap, residual);
          if (new_cap > best_cap[e.to]) {
            pq.erase({best_cap[e.to], e.to});
            best_cap[e.to] = new_cap;
            pq.emplace(best_cap[e.to], e.to);
            prev_edge[e.to] = eid;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    *bottleneck = best_cap[dst];
    vector<int> path;
    for (int e = prev_edge[dst]; e != -1; e = prev_edge[edges[e].from])
      path.push_back(e);
    return path;
  }

  double flow(int source, int sink) {
    Network res(vertices.size(), edges.size() * 2);
    vector<double> f(edges.size() * 2, 0.0);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < edges.size(); ++i) {
      res.link(edges[i].from, edges[i].to, edges[i].capacity);
      res.link(edges[i].to, edges[i].from, 0.0);
    }

    double total = 0.0;
    double cap;
    for (auto path = res.find_path(source, sink, f, &cap); !path.empty() && cap > 0;
         path = res.find_path(source, sink, f, &cap)) {
      for (int e : path) {
        int rev = (e % 2 == 1) ? e - 1 : e + 1;
        f[e] += cap;
        f[rev] -= cap;
      }
      total += cap;
    }

    for (int eid : res.vertices[source].incident_edges)
      total += f[eid];
    return total;
  }
};

struct Arc {
  int s, d;
  double w;
  Arc(int u, int v, double cap) : s(u), d(v), w(cap) {}
};

struct Node {
  vector<int> adj;
};

struct MaxFlowGraph {
  vector<Node> V;
  vector<Arc> E;

  MaxFlowGraph(int nodes, int edges_cap) : V(nodes), E() {
    E.reserve(edges_cap);
  }

  void link(int u, int v, double cap) {
    E.emplace_back(u, v, cap);
    V[u].adj.push_back(int(E.size()) - 1);
  }

  vector<int> dfs_path(int src, int dst, vector<double>& f, double* bneck) {
    using state = pair<double, int>;
    set<state, greater<state>> pq;
    vector<double> dist(V.size(), 0.0);
    vector<int> prev_edge(V.size(), -1);

    dist[src] = numeric_limits<double>::max();
    pq.emplace(dist[src], src);

    while (!pq.empty() && dist[dst] == 0.0) {
      auto [cap, node] = *pq.begin();
      pq.erase(pq.begin());

      for (int idx : V[node].adj) {
        const Arc& a = E[idx];
        double res = a.w - f[idx];
        if (res > 0) {
          double nc = min(cap, res);
          if (nc > dist[a.d]) {
            auto it = pq.find({dist[a.d], a.d});
            if (it != pq.end()) pq.erase(it);
            dist[a.d] = nc;
            pq.emplace(dist[a.d], a.d);
            prev_edge[a.d] = idx;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    *bneck = dist[dst];
    vector<int> path;
    for (int e = prev_edge[dst]; e != -1; e = prev_edge[E[e].s])
      path.push_back(e);
    return path;
  }

  double compute_flow(int s, int t) {
    MaxFlowGraph residual(V.size(), int(E.size()) * 2);
    vector<double> flow(2 * E.size(), 0.0);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < E.size(); ++i) {
      residual.link(E[i].s, E[i].d, E[i].w);
      residual.link(E[i].d, E[i].s, 0.0);
    }

    double total = 0.0;
    double cap;
    for (auto path = residual.dfs_path(s, t, flow, &cap);
         !path.empty() && cap > 0;
         path = residual.dfs_path(s, t, flow, &cap)) {
      for (int e : path) {
        int rev = (e % 2) ? e - 1 : e + 1;
        flow[e] += cap;
        flow[rev] -= cap;
      }
      total += cap;
    }

    for (int idx : residual.V[s].adj)
      total += flow[idx];
    return total;
  }
};
